hypothesis: The selected parent stages 1024 sources for 256 targets per CTA. A 2048-source tile paired with 512 targets per CTA halves the source-tile iterations at large sizes and increases source reuse per CTA. The four shared arrays use 32,768 bytes, below the 49,152-byte limit. Fewer CTAs and greater shared-memory use may offset those benefits; controller timing must determine the result.
notes: This is a single candidate, not a completed sweep. It preserves one thread per target, force arithmetic, self-interaction exclusion, and bounds checks for partial source tiles and target tails. The selected parent was correct with a three-repeat mean of 0.00112331 s and score 0.62254; a prior 768-source-tile candidate was correct with a 0.00102003 s mean and score 0.64492. These observations do not establish this candidate's performance. Request full correctness and official per-size geometric-mean timing evaluation.
